high_level_description: The image is a promotional graphic for the upcoming movie "Sonic 3." It features a young woman with long, wavy brown hair wearing a dark blue top. She appears to be the subject of the announcement, as indicated by the text overlay. In the background, there are two animated characters from the Sonic the Hedgehog series. On the left is a yellow anthropomorphic character with cat-like ears, wearing headphones and gloves, and holding a glowing blue object. This character resembles Tails, one of Sonic's friends.
